description: googleAdLibrary: Advertiser Search. GET /v1/google/adLibrary/advertisers/search. Search the Google Ad Transparency Library for advertisers to get their advertiser id. Pass region for non-US advertisers, like AU or CA. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 1 credit when websites is not empty. Costs 1 credit when advertisers is not empty. Costs 0 credits when advertisers is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

region.description: 2-letter country code to search in. Defaults to US when omitted.

name: google_adLibrary_advertisers_search
